    1: """
    2: Session 29Ba: PMNS Mixing Angle Extraction from Tridiagonal Kosmann Kernel
    3: ==========================================================================
    4: 
    5: Extracts the full 3x3 PMNS mixing matrix from the (0,0) singlet sector
    6: of the D_K Dirac operator on Jensen-deformed SU(3).
    7: 
    8: The singlet sector has 16 eigenvalues grouping into 3 distinct positive-energy
    9: levels (plus their particle-hole partners):
   10:   L1: multiplicity 1 (gap-edge singlet)
   11:   L2: multiplicity 4 (quadruplet)
   12:   L3: multiplicity 3 (triplet)
   13: 
   14: Selection rules (Session 23a):
   15:   V(L1, L2) ~ 0.07-0.13 (nearest-neighbor)
   16:   V(L1, L3) = 0 EXACTLY (selection rule)
   17:   V(L2, L3) ~ 0.01-0.03 (nearest-neighbor)
   18: 
   19: Three analysis methods:
   20:   Method A: Full 16x16 H_eff diagonalization, extract 3 smallest positive eigenvalues
   21:   Method B: Degenerate perturbation theory -> 3x3 reduction
   22:   Method C: Single-mode 3x3 (individual coupling, not Frobenius norm)
   23: 
   24: Gate B-29b: sin^2(theta_13) < 0.005 or > 0.10 -> tridiagonal PMNS fails
   25: Gate P-29b: sin^2(theta_13) in [0.015, 0.030] -> PASS
   26: 
   27: Input: s23a_kosmann_singlet.npz
   28: Output: s29b_pmns_extraction.npz
   29: """
